description: This file defines the EventHubDataAdapter class, which implements the IEventHubDataAdapter interface. It provides methods to convert between EventHub messages and internal cached representations, handles stream position and sequence tokens, and serializes message payloads for Azure Event Hubs within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: EventHubDataAdapter
classes.description: Handles conversion between EventHub message format and internal cache, serializes/deserializes event data, and manages stream position and tokens.

methods.name: GetBatchContainer
methods.description: Converts a CachedMessage to a batch container for streaming.

methods.name: GetBatchContainer
methods.description: Converts an EventHubMessage to a batch container.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token from a cached message.

methods.name: ToQueueMessage
methods.description: Converts stream events into EventData messages suitable for enqueueing.

methods.name: FromQueueMessage
methods.description: Creates a CachedMessage object from an EventData message.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Gets the stream position (identity and token) from EventData.

methods.name: GetOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the offset string from a cached message segment.

methods.name: GetPartitionKey
methods.description: Retrieves the partition key for a given stream ID.

methods.name: GetStreamIdentity
methods.description: Extracts the stream identity from an EventData message.
